bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet leverage (Debt/Equity, including current & non-current borrowings and lease liabilities) has declined from 0.04 in FY22 to 0.00 in FY26, indicating growth funded largely without incremental debt.
- Return on Net Worth was 17.5% in FY26, down from a 24.7% peak in FY22 as the equity base and capex have scaled; EBITDA grew from INR 949 Mn (FY22) to INR 1,522 Mn (FY26) on revenue up from INR 5,301 Mn to INR 8,279 Mn.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Positions itself as a global leader in Anti-histamines, Anti-Allergic, Vitamins, Anti-Asthmatics & Anesthetics with a niche basket of 40+ APIs sold to 1,500+ customers across 120+ countries.
- Backed by 4x USFDA, 2x ANVISA and 2x KFDA approvals plus WHO-GMP, ISO, Halal (incl. Indonesian Halal) and FAMI-QS certifications; holds 50+ country registrations, 21 USDMFs and 14 CEPs.
- Long-standing relationships with global pharma names (Ryntec, Akums, LGM Pharma, LNK Biosciences among named partners); export sales were 82% of revenue in FY26 and top-10 customer concentration eased to 52% (from 58% in FY25) as the company works to further diversify its customer base.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Management] Family-promoter led leadership: Satish Wagh (Executive Chairman & WTD), Saloni Wagh (Managing Director, Ph.D. in chemistry), Shivani Wagh (Joint Managing Director), and CFO Krishna Raghunathan (CA, previously with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories and Granules India).
- [R&D] Ambernath API R&D facility is fully commissioned with a 16-scientist team and advanced instrumentation (HRMS/MS, GC-MS/MS, HPLC, GC, FTIR); the company has filed 4 process patents in India (as of March 2026) at its DSIR-approved facility, supported overall by 68+ scientists across two R&D centres (Ambernath - formulations/generic APIs; Lote - lifecycle improvement).
- [CMO/CDMO] Expanding API customer base across Japan, EU and US with regulatory filings underway (EU-GMP, COFEPRIS, Health Canada); plans to file six EU dossiers this financial year, agreements secured in South Asia with ROW supplies initiated from the finished-dosage division, and a novel combination product under discussion with an innovator partner.

deepdive.thesis: Supriya Lifescience reported strong Q4FY26 results with revenue growth of 50% YoY, driven by favorable product mix, expanding global demand, and disciplined cost management, and the company remains focused on executing its strategic priorities to achieve its FY27 revenue target of INR1,000 crores.
